description: WeChat module (去广告⑥) for Official Account articles. Only mp.weixin.qq.com is decrypted; this module owns that host, so app-ads imports no rule or decryption there. scripts: routes handled by scripts/wechat.js, each with sample URLs; probes lists the critical content URLs a route touches on purpose (only the article page, whose script adds a style element and edits the ad entries of the transfer table, nothing else). rewrites answer pure ad calls with an empty JSON object. negative: article functions no rewrite or script may match. Findings behind each rule: docs/WECHAT.md.
